posts.body:
Hello you can call me raindoe. I didn't just go with that since I wanted to use a different user.
I created an account yesterday
I recently started using RPG MAKER MV, like a couple of months ago or something. Haven't really been on since I've more of been planning.
I like to laze around and stuff, such as playing rhythm games or watching anime. But I mainly listen to music in freetime.
So, yeah. Nice to meet you, and I hope to be able to chat with people.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
If your age on your profile is accurate, then I really envy you! I wish I had discovered RPG Maker when I was much younger. I only started about 3 years ago in my 50s. So much wasted time! But better late than never I suppose.
This is a pretty great community.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!

posts.author: lazybumpkinalert
posts.body: Thank you both! I'll use my youth as a headstart to my dreams.
